footer.tagline: AI-powered E2E testing that scans, tests, and heals — so you ship with confidence.

metadata.title: AWT — AI-Powered E2E Testing
metadata.description: Just enter a URL. AI generates test scenarios, executes them with Playwright, and reports results. No code required.

landing.heroSub: AI-Powered E2E Testing That Heals Itself
landing.heroDesc: AWT scans your site, generates test scenarios with AI, executes them with Playwright, and auto-fixes failures. The DevQA loop that never sleeps.
landing.loopDesc: Most testing tools stop at failure. AWT keeps going — analyzing, fixing, and retesting until everything passes.
landing.loopStep1Desc: Crawl your site, analyze DOM structure, detect features like login forms and shopping carts
landing.loopStep2Desc: AI generates test scenarios as declarative YAML — no code required
landing.loopStep3Desc: Review, edit, or approve AI-generated scenarios before execution
landing.loopStep4Desc: Playwright runs tests with live screenshots, human-like mouse movements
landing.loopStep5Desc: Failed? AI analyzes the cause, suggests fixes, creates a PR, and re-tests automatically
landing.diffDesc: What makes AWT different from every other testing tool
landing.diff1Desc: No code required. Define tests in plain YAML that anyone on your team can read and edit.
landing.diff2Desc: Test fails → AI analyzes → code fix → PR created → re-test. The loop repeats until green.
landing.diff3Desc: CSS selectors break. AWT uses OpenCV template matching, OCR, and feature detection to find elements visually.
landing.diff4Desc: Every successful match is stored in SQLite. AWT gets smarter with each test run — same mistakes never happen twice.
landing.costDesc: We obsess over token efficiency so you don't have to
landing.costStat3Label: scenario builder: deterministic → heuristic → AI fallback
landing.costFeat1: Prompt caching — repeat tests cost near zero
landing.costFeat3: Pattern-based scenarios avoid AI calls entirely
landing.pricingFreeDesc: Try AI testing with basic features
landing.pricingProDesc: For professional developers and small teams
landing.pricingTeamDesc: For teams that need high volume testing
landing.ctaDesc: Start testing in under 5 minutes. No credit card required.
landing.featDesc: Built for developers who care about testing quality
landing.feat1Desc: Bezier curve mouse movement at 60fps, variable typing delays (50-300ms). Passes bot detection that linear automation fails.
landing.feat2Desc: Auto-detects login forms, shopping carts, search bars, pagination — then generates targeted tests for each feature.
landing.feat3Desc: Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama. Bring your own key or run fully offline with local LLMs.
landing.feat4Desc: Manual (terminal prompt), Branch (git isolation + auto-merge), Auto (direct fix + retest). Choose your risk level.
landing.feat5Desc: WebSocket-powered live screenshots (960×540), step-by-step progress, event log — watch AI test your site in real time.
landing.feat6Desc: Pytesseract with 10+ languages. Find buttons and text in English, Korean, Japanese, Thai — no selectors needed.
landing.feat7Desc: PyAutoGUI for OS-level testing — native app screenshots, system keyboard input, multi-monitor support.
landing.feat8Desc: AI fixes go to aat/fix-### branches. Auto-commit, auto-retest, auto-merge on pass. Full audit trail.
landing.demoDesc: Watch AWT scan a site, generate scenarios, and execute tests — all from the browser.
landing.yamlDesc: No programming required. Anyone on your team can read, edit, and maintain test scenarios.
landing.yamlFeat1: navigate, click, type, assert — intuitive action verbs
landing.yamlFeat2: OCR, template, feature matching — find elements visually
landing.yamlFeat3: humanize: true — Bezier mouse + random typing delays
landing.yamlNlDesc: Describe what you want to test in plain language — AI converts it to YAML scenarios automatically.
landing.yamlNlExample: "Login, then go to My Page and check if profile editing works"
landing.loopFeedback: Failed? Loop back to Step 01 automatically
landing.skillDesc: Choose how AWT fits your workflow
landing.skillModeDesc: Your AI coding tool is the brain. AWT is the eyes and hands. No extra AI API key needed.
landing.skillModeFeat3: Your AI reads failures + source code
landing.skillModeFeat4: Your AI fixes the code directly
landing.cloudModeDesc: No install needed. Sign up, enter a URL, and watch AI generate and execute tests.
landing.cloudModeFeat4: BYOK — bring your own AI key
landing.cliModeDesc: AWT handles everything independently. Best for CI/CD pipelines and automation.
landing.cliModeFeat1: aat generate creates scenarios via AI

testDetail.consoleDisclaimer: These are browser console logs from the target site, not AWT errors. They help diagnose issues with the site being tested.
testDetail.explain_http400_desc: The server could not understand the request. Check input values or API parameters.
testDetail.explain_http401_desc: Login is required or the token has expired. Check your authentication status.
testDetail.explain_http403_desc: You don't have permission for this resource. Check user permission settings.
testDetail.explain_http404_desc: The requested page or API does not exist. Verify the URL is correct.
testDetail.explain_http5xx_desc: An internal server error occurred. Check server logs for details.
testDetail.explain_cors_desc: Cross-origin request was blocked. Check the server's CORS header configuration.
testDetail.explain_network_desc: Network connection failed. Verify the server is running and accessible.
testDetail.explain_webgl_desc: GPU-related warning. Can be safely ignored if functionality is not affected.
testDetail.explain_mixed_desc: Loading HTTP resources on an HTTPS page. Switch all resources to HTTPS.
testDetail.explain_typeError_desc: A value of wrong type was used. Check for null/undefined access or invalid function calls.
testDetail.explain_refError_desc: An undefined variable or function was used. Check variable declarations and scope.
testDetail.explain_deprecated_desc: Using a deprecated feature. Migrate to the recommended replacement API.
testDetail.noGithubConnected: Connect GitHub in Settings to create auto-fix PRs.
testDetail.fixErrorNoAiKey: No AI API key configured. Please set it in Settings.
testDetail.fixErrorGenFailed: AI failed to generate a fix. Please try again later.
testDetail.fixErrorService: AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
testDetail.fixErrorTimeout: Request timed out. Please try again.
testDetail.fixErrorGeneric: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
testDetail.warnMajorDeletion: This change deletes most of the file. Review carefully.
testDetail.warnImportsRemoved: All import statements are removed. The file may not function.
testDetail.warnReplacedWithStub: A large block of code is replaced with a very short snippet.
testDetail.warnExcessiveDeletion: Deletions exceed additions by 10x or more.
